method: Studio economics per BRIEF.md: fx 3.3, VAT 18%, card 2%+₪1.2, returns 8% of net, packaging 0; shipping for qty q = unit + (q-1)*max(0, unit-3.72); cheapest shipping option to IL, plus the cheapest option within 20 days (within_20d). retail_ils = the slot's Israeli-value price from data/economics/pricing/other-rooms-2026-10-11.json (pairs and sets at the set price, qty = units). Margin before CAC.

sources_checked.CJ: run profit-fix-rest-lighting: 17 searches (listV2) + 6 product opens + 11 freight quotes = 1,380 points (42 calls, including 8 calls lost to HTTP 429 that were still charged); plus the cached searches of the living-room lighting group (cloth/fabric/linen/paper/pleated/silk/wabi pendants, linen/fabric/swing-arm/plug-in wall lamps, travertine). Results cached under data/sources/cj/.
sources_checked.AliExpress: repo API data only: scale-2026-10/screen (all rooms, 1,915 lighting rows), scale-2026-10/detail + deep-2026-10 (all rooms), review sheets, data/sources/aliexpress cache. No aliexpress.com browsing.
sources_checked.Zendrop: mcp get_catalog_products (pendant light, fabric lamp, wall lamp, floor lamp, table lamp) + shipping estimates to IL for 5 lamps: $28.41-82.35 per lamp (wall lamps 2016351 $30.18, 3136885 $28.41, 2016617 $37.16; floor lamp 2896731 $82.35; pendant 2755522 $35.05) -> none profitable at the slots' prices.
sources_checked.Israel: public pages only (d.co.il directory, zauderer.co.il, nordlight.co.il via the lighting group); no contact made.
